factors.name: Warmth
factors.shortDesc: Degree of interpersonal warmth, engagement, and emotional closeness with others.
factors.detailedDesc: Warmth reflects how openly a person connects with people, participates in group activities, and expresses empathy versus preferring solitary focus and objective emotional detachment.
factors.lowPoleDesc: Values personal boundaries, privacy, and objectivity. Tends to work independently, focusing on facts rather than emotional nuances.
factors.averagePoleDesc: Balances cordiality with necessary professional detachment. Friendly when required without being overly reliant on socializing.
factors.highPoleDesc: Naturally welcoming, expressive, and empathetic. Thrives in collaborative teams and easily builds rapport with diverse individuals.
factors.workplaceImpact: High A excels in client relations, team cohesion, and care roles; Low A excels in technical solitude and objective analysis.

factors.name: Reasoning
factors.shortDesc: Mental processing capacity, conceptual problem-solving, and abstract reasoning.
factors.detailedDesc: Reasoning measures the preference for theoretical conceptualization and fast pattern recognition versus pragmatic, hands-on, step-by-step logic.
factors.lowPoleDesc: Prefers tangible, real-world examples and established procedures over hypothetical models or ambiguity.
factors.averagePoleDesc: Handles both concrete tasks and conceptual problem-solving comfortably according to daily job demands.
factors.highPoleDesc: Quick to synthesize complex data, identify underlying systemic patterns, and enjoy intellectual challenges.
factors.workplaceImpact: High B thrives in strategy, complex architecture, and research; Low B excels in straightforward operational execution.

factors.name: Emotional Stability
factors.shortDesc: Dynamic resilience, emotional equilibrium, and capacity to handle stress constructively.
factors.detailedDesc: Assesses coping capacity under pressure, consistency of mood, and resilience when faced with sudden obstacles or setbacks.
factors.lowPoleDesc: Emotionally sensitive and reactive to stressors. Highly attuned to environmental friction and interpersonal tension.
factors.averagePoleDesc: Demonstrates standard resilience; remains steady during normal workloads with occasional stress during severe crises.
factors.highPoleDesc: Remarkably unflappable, composed, and adaptable under high-pressure scenarios and crisis management.
factors.workplaceImpact: High C provides an anchor in chaotic environments; Low C acts as an early sensor for organizational friction.

factors.name: Dominance
factors.shortDesc: Propensity to take charge, assert opinions, lead, and influence social dynamics.
factors.detailedDesc: Evaluates the tendency toward assertiveness, direct persuasion, and authority versus accommodation and harmonious compliance.
factors.lowPoleDesc: Cooperative, accommodating, and peace-seeking. Prefers consensus and avoids unnecessary confrontation.
factors.averagePoleDesc: Asserts viewpoints when appropriate while respecting the authority and input of colleagues.
factors.highPoleDesc: Direct, competitive, and decisive. Naturally assumes leadership and takes initiative to drive outcomes.
factors.workplaceImpact: High E drives initiatives and leads teams; Low E builds collaborative bridges and supports consensus.

factors.name: Liveliness
factors.shortDesc: Spontaneity, enthusiasm, expressive energy, and cheerfulness.
factors.detailedDesc: Reflects the degree of spontaneous energy, optimism, and verbal expressiveness compared with measured caution and deliberate restraint.
factors.lowPoleDesc: Quiet, prudent, and restrained. Thinks carefully before speaking and takes commitments with sober seriousness.
factors.averagePoleDesc: Shows balanced enthusiasm; can be lively in celebratory settings and focused in formal meetings.
factors.highPoleDesc: Energetic, cheerful, and enthusiastic. Brings vitality, humor, and optimism into meetings and social groups.
factors.workplaceImpact: High F energizes morale, sales, and presentations; Low F excels in audit, compliance, and meticulous scrutiny.

factors.name: Rule-Consciousness
factors.shortDesc: Adherence to societal rules, moral duty, standards, and institutional guidelines.
factors.detailedDesc: Measures standard adherence, conscientiousness, and commitment to obligations versus expediency and unconventional flexibility.
factors.lowPoleDesc: Flexible, adaptable, and willing to bend formal rules to solve novel problems quickly or challenge conventions.
factors.averagePoleDesc: Respects fundamental standards while applying sensible pragmatic judgment when exceptions arise.
factors.highPoleDesc: Highly conscientious, reliable, and dutiful. Values integrity, protocols, and meticulous moral responsibility.
factors.workplaceImpact: High G ensures regulatory compliance, quality control, and reliability; Low G fosters innovative rule-breaking.

factors.name: Social Boldness
factors.shortDesc: Confidence and fearlessness in public speaking, new social situations, and risk exposure.
factors.detailedDesc: Assesses comfort in high-visibility roles, speaking before strangers, approaching unfamiliar groups, and taking social risks.
factors.lowPoleDesc: Sensitive to social scrutiny; prefers small, familiar groups and quiet observation over the spotlight.
factors.averagePoleDesc: Comfortable interacting in standard business meetings; balances caution with reasonable social presence.
factors.highPoleDesc: Adventurous, socially confident, and resilient to social rejection. Enjoys networking and large public stages.
factors.workplaceImpact: High H excels in business development, pitching, and media presence; Low H thrives in focused backstage execution.

factors.name: Sensitivity
factors.shortDesc: Aesthetic appreciation, intuitive empathy, and artistic sensitivity vs pragmatic realism.
factors.detailedDesc: Evaluates the balance between emotional intuition, artistic depth, and tender sentiment versus utilitarian pragmatism.
factors.lowPoleDesc: Practical, realistic, and unsentimental. Focuses on tangible utility, facts, and logical efficiency.
factors.averagePoleDesc: Appreciates aesthetic and human factors without losing sight of practical deadlines and resource limits.
factors.highPoleDesc: Imaginative, empathetic, and culturally refined. Sensitive to subtle emotional tones, aesthetics, and nuance.
factors.workplaceImpact: High I contributes design intuition, user empathy, and cultural awareness; Low I maintains hardheaded operational focus.

factors.name: Vigilance
factors.shortDesc: Degree of skepticism, wariness regarding intentions of others vs instinctive trust.
factors.detailedDesc: Measures how readily a person trusts motives versus maintaining critical skepticism and vigilance against hidden agendas.
factors.lowPoleDesc: Unconditionally trusting, tolerant, and forgiving. Believes in the good intentions of others and easily cooperates.
factors.averagePoleDesc: Displays realistic caution without being cynically suspicious; verifies facts before making major commitments.
factors.highPoleDesc: Inquisitive, guarded, and discerning. Questions assumptions, scrutinizes motives, and guards against exploitation.
factors.workplaceImpact: High L excels in risk auditing, fraud detection, and legal review; Low L excels in fostering open team trust.

factors.name: Abstractedness
factors.shortDesc: Focus on inner ideas, conceptual imagination, and creative reflection vs sensory reality.
factors.detailedDesc: Distinguishes between a daydreaming, idea-generating mindset and an observant, grounded focus on immediate physical surroundings.
factors.lowPoleDesc: Down-to-earth, observant, and practical. Attentive to immediate physical surroundings and actionable details.
factors.averagePoleDesc: Balances creative brainstorming with practical execution and day-to-day administrative follow-through.
factors.highPoleDesc: Visionary, introspective, and creative. Absorbed in abstract ideas, theoretical possibilities, and artistic concepts.
factors.workplaceImpact: High M generates breakthrough innovation and long-term vision; Low M manages detail-heavy logistics and operations.

factors.name: Privateness
factors.shortDesc: Tendency to keep thoughts and feelings guarded vs being candid, open, and transparent.
factors.detailedDesc: Assesses diplomatic discretion, self-containment, and calculated presentation versus uninhibited transparency.
factors.lowPoleDesc: Direct, candid, and emotionally transparent. Openly shares feelings, thoughts, and opinions without filter.
factors.averagePoleDesc: Appropriately diplomatic; shares personal perspectives with trusted colleagues while maintaining professional discretion.
factors.highPoleDesc: Discreet, polished, and socially guarded. Carefully considers what to reveal and maintains a composed personal boundary.
factors.workplaceImpact: High N thrives in confidential negotiations and diplomatic PR; Low N builds fast genuine rapport through authenticity.

factors.name: Apprehension
factors.shortDesc: Degree of self-confidence and serenity vs self-criticism, anxiety, and vulnerability.
factors.detailedDesc: Measures feelings of adequacy, self-assurance, and resilience to guilt versus self-scrutiny, self-blame, and anticipatory worry.
factors.lowPoleDesc: Confident, unflappable, and self-assured. Rare feelings of guilt or self-doubt; moves on quickly from mistakes.
factors.averagePoleDesc: Maintains healthy self-esteem while possessing enough humility to acknowledge errors and learn from criticism.
factors.highPoleDesc: Self-aware, conscientious, and prone to worry. Scrutinizes own performance deeply and cares immensely about outcomes.
factors.workplaceImpact: High O drives perfectionism and high personal standards; Low O provides unwavering confidence in decisive moments.

factors.name: Openness to Change
factors.shortDesc: Receptiveness to novel ideas, unconventional methods, modern experimentation, and reform.
factors.detailedDesc: Measures preference for established customs, predictable traditions, and time-tested methods versus eagerness to experiment.
factors.lowPoleDesc: Values tradition, proven track records, stability, and historical precedent. Skeptical of unproven fads.
factors.averagePoleDesc: Welcomes constructive improvements while respecting institutional memory and established foundations.
factors.highPoleDesc: Progressive, inquisitive, and experimental. Eager to challenge status quos, adopt modern tools, and explore uncharted paths.
factors.workplaceImpact: High Q1 drives digital transformation and agile experimentation; Low Q1 preserves organizational continuity.

factors.name: Self-Reliance
factors.shortDesc: Preference for independent decision-making and solitary work vs group consensus.
factors.detailedDesc: Evaluates the need for collective consultation and community companionship versus autonomous self-sufficiency.
factors.lowPoleDesc: Social, team-oriented, and collaborative. Thrives on collective decision-making and group camaraderie.
factors.averagePoleDesc: Enjoys team brainstorming but is equally capable of executing independent solo assignments.
factors.highPoleDesc: Autonomous, self-directed, and independent. Prefers making own decisions and working without constant supervision.
factors.workplaceImpact: High Q2 excels in remote autonomy and lone research; Low Q2 excels in building community and cross-functional teams.

factors.name: Perfectionism
factors.shortDesc: Planfulness, self-control, organizational discipline, and attention to systematic order.
factors.detailedDesc: Assesses goal-directed willpower, systematic planning, neatness, and self-discipline versus spontaneous flexibility.
factors.lowPoleDesc: Tolerant of disorder, spontaneous, and informal. Comfortable improvising on the fly without rigid agendas.
factors.averagePoleDesc: Maintains orderly workflows and meets deadlines without becoming overly rigid or obsessive.
factors.highPoleDesc: Methodical, disciplined, and highly structured. Takes pride in precision, organization, and deliberate execution.
factors.workplaceImpact: High Q3 delivers flawless project management and operational rigor; Low Q3 adapts swiftly in chaotic startups.

factors.name: Tension
factors.shortDesc: Internal drive, urgent energy, restless tension, and frustration tolerance.
factors.detailedDesc: Reflects restless energy, drive for immediate action, and irritability versus relaxed tranquility and unhurried composure.
factors.lowPoleDesc: Placid, composed, and patient. Rarely feels rushed; maintains a relaxed, tranquil state of mind.
factors.averagePoleDesc: Possesses adequate internal motivation to meet deadlines while maintaining basic personal peace.
factors.highPoleDesc: High-octane, driven, and urgently focused on speed. Highly motivated to get things done immediately.
factors.workplaceImpact: High Q4 provides restless drive and urgency to finish tasks; Low Q4 provides patience and soothing composure.

domains.name: Extraversion
domains.description: Social energy, relational engagement, and assertive public presence.

domains.name: Anxiety
domains.description: Vulnerability to emotional reactivity, worry, and nervous tension.

domains.name: Tough-Mindedness
domains.description: Pragmatic, cognitive realism vs aesthetic empathy and sensitivity.

domains.name: Independence
domains.description: Self-directed assertion, autonomy, and intellectual freedom.

domains.name: Self-Control
domains.description: Disciplined impulse regulation, moral conscientiousness, and planfulness.
